from scipy.optimize import least_squares
y=dP_dt
fams={
 'logist_plus_c': lambda p: p[0]*P*(1-P/p[1])+p[2],
 'cos': lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*np.cos(p[2]*P)+p[3]*P,
 'sqrtform': lambda p: p[0]*np.sqrt(np.abs(p[1]-P))+p[2]*P,
 'exp_quad': lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*P)*(1+p[2]*P)+p[3],
 'pow': lambda p: p[0]*(p[1]-P)**p[2]+p[3]*P+p[4],
 'tanh': lambda p: p[0]*np.tanh(p[1]*(p[2]-P))+p[3],
 'poly3_exp': lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**3,
}
for k,f in fams.items():
    best=None
    for s in range(20):
        p0=np.random.RandomState(s).randn(5)*2
        p0[1]=abs(p0[1])+3 if k in('logist_plus_c','pow','sqrtform') else p0[1]
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-y, p0)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception as e: pass
    print(k, np.sqrt(2*best.cost/len(y)), np.round(best.x,4))
